parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the broad Verifiers project requirements, including parsers, rubrics, environments, grouped environments, mock client, examples, docs, and packaging.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent created foundation files and launched five child scopes: parsers/rubrics, utilities/scripts/trainers/inference, docs/metadata, bundled example environments/examples, and MockAsyncOpenAI. No child or parent step owned the core verifiers/envs package implementation.
parallel.implementation: Children wrote substantial parser, rubric, utility, docs, examples, and mock-client files directly into the shared workspace. The required core environment modules such as environment.py, singleturn_env.py, multiturn_env.py, and env_group.py were not implemented.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent received completed summaries from four children and a failed result from the environment/examples child, but timed out before top-level export wiring, integration checks, or final delivery.
parallel.verification: Verification stayed local to child scopes. Agent-1 explicitly could not end-to-end test until the environments module landed, and the official evaluator later recorded 0 of 171.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The core env API was absent, the broad environment/examples child did not return a completed handoff, the parent made no final integration pass, and the run timed out.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the complete package and test-suite obligation and treated the prompt as matching the real verifiers project API.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One agent retained ownership of discovery, copying a reference implementation, dependency edits, targeted compatibility fixes, testing, and final closure.
serial.implementation: The serial run chose verifiers v0.1.6 as the closest match, copied the coherent tree including verifiers/envs, tests, docs, examples, and metadata, then adapted pyproject and fixed MockAsyncOpenAI, Rubric.score_rollout, and Environment.make_dataset.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The same actor installed the package, verified top-level exports, kept the copied tree coherent, and delivered a final project summary.
serial.verification: It ran the eight core test files, the full 171-test suite, coverage-enabled tests, spec-node checks, and a final import plus full-test command before finishing.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluation still marked solution_passed false with 152 of 171, but the visible serial trajectory shows far more complete package coverage than the parallel run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel saw the full project prompt but its work allocation omitted an owner for the required core environment classes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial treated the prompt as a full Verifiers package recreation and included the core env package in the copied/adapted implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The main requirement gap is not the prompt itself but parallel's failure to cover a required implementation family that serial covered.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into five child scopes, all productive in narrow areas but with no owner for the central env implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept ownership centralized and therefore carried discovery, implementation, adaptation, and verification across one coherent workspace.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's ownership map left a required implementation branch uncovered, while serial's single owner preserved end-to-end accountability.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children depended on interfaces from other scopes; agent-1 specifically reported that its work could not be end-to-end tested until env modules landed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used a coherent reference tree, so env, rubric, parser, utils, tests, and exports came from a compatible implementation baseline before targeted edits.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a visible missing shared interface and no owner to supply it; serial avoided that boundary by bringing in the compatible implementation together.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel hand-wrote independent subsystems from scratch and produced many files, but the core env package never appeared as an owned implementation path.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial copied a real project tree, selected v0.1.6 as the best API match, and then patched concrete mismatches found by example checks and tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial started from a complete integrated implementation, while parallel assembled partial subsystems around a missing core.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent received completed child results from four scopes but got a failed result for the active environment/examples child after cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; it progressed through local commands and ended with a final summary after verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's final dependency was trapped in a failed child lifecycle, while serial's single actor never needed to join or recover child work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children wrote into the shared workspace, but the parent did not perform a final integration pass and the visible artifact file list lacks the core verifiers/envs package.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial's artifact file list includes verifiers/envs modules and tests, and the serial parent verified exports from the integrated package.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel delivered a shared tree of partial subsystem side effects; serial delivered a coherent package tree with env modules integrated.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verification was scoped to child-local checks, and a child explicitly stated full testing was blocked on the absent environments module.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran core tests, all tests, coverage-enabled tests, and a final export plus full-test command before ending.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel never reached whole-package acceptance, while serial repeatedly checked the integrated package even though the official result still failed 19 tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the run window, timed out, cancelled the active child, and closed without a final integration or response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed without timeout, had remaining budget, and ended with a final summary after verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's allocation left the parent waiting until cancellation, while serial retained enough closure window for final checks and summary.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official relation is both_fail because both completed evaluations have solution_passed false. The concrete task-solving gap is nevertheless large: parallel scored 0/171 after timing out with no core verifiers/envs implementation owner and a cancelled overbroad environment/examples child, while serial scored 152/171 after copying a coherent reference implementation, including env modules, adapting it, and running the full test suite.
parallel_contributors: No owner was assigned to produce the required core environment implementation.
The broad environment/examples assignment remained on one child until cancellation and left the parent without a completed handoff.
The parent never reached whole-package integration or acceptance testing.
serial_contributors: The serial run selected a reference implementation matching the prompt's API and copied a full coherent package tree.
It made targeted fixes for spec examples and test failures.
It ran all visible tests and final import checks before closure.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel hand-wrote partial modules and skeletons, while serial used an existing complete implementation baseline.
Serial still officially failed 19 of 171 tests despite local full-test success; the visible pair files do not expose the individual official failures.
evaluator_effects: The official status records, not the agents' local summaries, determine both pass flags; this makes the relation both_fail even with the 0/171 versus 152/171 quality gap.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors to the quality gap, not an exclusive root cause and not a pass/fail-discordant outcome
